# TabiChain Community: Project Development Dynamics

TabiChain is an innovative Layer 1 blockchain focused on consumer applications, games, and finance in Web3. The project positions itself as a "decentralized network for consumer finance," backed by major investors like Animoca Brands and YZi Labs, and aims to attract up to 8 billion users in the future of Web3. Since the testnet launch in early 2024, TabiChain has shown impressive growth, particularly thanks to its active community, which plays a key role in the ecosystem's development.

## Project Development: From Testnet to Mainnet

TabiChain is built on the Cosmos SDK with full EVM compatibility, enabling high throughput—up to 200,000 TPS, instant transaction finalization, and parallel processing. Key innovations include the Omni Execution Layer for cross-platform apps (Telegram, Line, Twitter) and PolymorphismVM, which supports multiple programming languages, lowering barriers for Web2 developers.

The project's roadmap is ambitious: Testnet V2 launched in August 2024 with over 100 million transactions and 20+ games in development. Mainnet is expected in the first quarter of 2025, coinciding with the $TABI airdrop—a token with a dual model ($TABI and $veTABI) for staking and governance. The project has attracted $10–11 million in investments from Binance Labs, Hashkey, and others, confirming its potential in gaming and DeFi.

Recent updates include integration with Pyth Entropy for randomness in games and lotteries, as well as the User Distribution Engine—a tool for targeted user distribution based on on-chain and off-chain data, solving the Web3 adoption problem. Partnerships with SuperVerse for gaming and AEON for payments at 20 million+ merchants (including McDonald's and Starbucks) are expanding the ecosystem.

TabiChain focuses on a "Proof-of-Attention" model: users earn for attention and participation, while developers earn for app quality through leaderboards and voting. This creates sustainable growth, integrating Web2 traffic via Tabilink (social logins like Telegram) and TabiPay for zero-fee payments.

## Community: The Heart of the Ecosystem

The TabiChain community is a global network of enthusiasts, with over 1.4 million followers on X (@Tabichain) and a Telegram group exceeding 200,000 members. TabiZoo—a Telegram mini-app—has become a hub for onboarding: users claim NFT Shiro, complete quests, and mint MiniNodes for $30–50, earning rewards and voting rights. Over 320,000 subscribers actively participate in "coin rain" and gacha mechanics, turning onboarding into a game.

Activity is evident in AMA sessions (Latam, Korea, Singapore), where the community discusses updates with hosts like @TabiCyclo. Local hubs—@TabichainKR (462 followers), @TabichainCN (1274)—promote the project in Asian markets, with partnerships in Vietnam (MCN) and the Philippines (food delivery). Ambassadors like @Bigjoe8312 and @SRYamin1 create content about SBT programs and rewards for participation.

KOLs like @BitmonkCrypto highlight the Poly-Apps framework for seamless integration, while the community votes for dApps via Captain Nodes. With 100+ projects on the testnet and a focus on retention, TabiChain is building an "amusement park" for billions of users.

In the end, the TabiChain community isn't just fans—it's co-creators: from quests in Zealy to global events. The project evolves thanks to feedback, making Web3 accessible. Join the Tabizen—the future is here! 💢
@Tabichain @TabiPayHQ @Tabizens

✊🏾 WE, THE 99%
The People’s G20 Summit
📅 20–22 November 2025
📍 Constitution Hill, Johannesburg, South Africa

🌍 Why We’re Rising
While the G20 meets behind closed doors to serve the 1%, we — the 99% — will gather in Johannesburg to claim our power.
This is not a side event. It’s a direct counter-summit: a people’s space of resistance, solidarity, and action led by movements, workers, women, youth, and communities from across South Africa, Africa, and the Global South.

✊🏿 What Justice Demands 
✅ Tax the 1% — make billionaires & corporations pay their fair share.
✅ End Corruption — stop the theft of resources and invest in public services.
✅ Drop the debt — build a fair deal that invests in people not banks.
✅ Corporate Accountability — for environmental destruction, labour abuses and human rights violations. 
✅ Remake Multilateralism  — rebuild fair global institutions to serve people, not power.
✅ Climate justice now — rich nations must pay their climate debt.
✅ Value & redistribute care work — health, education & community first.
✅ End Hunger — invest in local food production and people’s right to eat. 

🔥 Why Join
↔️Our struggles are connected - we are reclaiming our collective imagination for a just world!
🫶🏾Connect with movements from South Africa, the Global Majority & the world
💪🏾Join groups to share ideas, organise, resist & build alternatives
🎇Take part in a festival of justice, solidarity & culture

🎶 Programme for the 3 Days of Power
Day 1: Memory, Movements & Action
Storytelling • Debates • Grassroots voices
Day 2: Solutions Festival
Alternatives • Artivism • Living libraries • Street actions
Day 3: 99% Uprising Rally & Concert – celebrate each other and commit to the cause
• Global artists • Cultural performances  • Launching Declaration

🌐 Get Involved Now
👉🏾👉🏾👉🏾 Visit https://t.co/aQmHng8Z4U 
On the website you can:
⏩Register to participate as an organisation or an individual activist.
⏩Pledge solidarity and join working groups 
⏩Stay updated - and choose how we keep you informed.
⏩Organise runway events, or link your existing event to the programme of action to build momentum towards November.

From Soweto to São Paulo, Manila to Mombasa, Cairo to Kingston, we are organising, marching, teaching, dreaming, resisting!

✨ Power to the People, Our Struggle is Now!
 
We are the 99%, and we are Rising.
